criteria.description: Gateway event module provides typed event, endpoint, subscription, delivery attempt, decision, channel connection, and handler registry primitives.
criteria.evidence: joyus-ai-mcp-server/src/gateway-events/** implemented; npm run typecheck passed; npm test -- gateway-events passed with 33 tests.
criteria.notes: Fixtures use generic tenants, operators, dashboards, webhooks, review decisions, and monitoring alerts.

criteria.description: Drizzle schema and migration persist tenant-scoped gateway tables with idempotency, retry, audit, and channel indexes.
criteria.notes: Gateway schema is registered with the shared Drizzle schema registry.

criteria.description: Gateway routes cover events, endpoints, subscriptions, delivery inspection, and decisions with tenant validation.
criteria.evidence: Route and service tests cover tenant mismatch, duplicate idempotency, inactive endpoints, decisions, and delivery outcomes.
criteria.notes: Routes are mounted at /gateway behind bearer auth and tenant resolution.

criteria.description: Dashboard and webhook backends work through a shared adapter boundary; Slack, email, and channel use the same abstraction.
criteria.evidence: delivery.service.test.ts covers dashboard sent, webhook failure sanitization, Slack/email stubs, and channel skipped_no_channel.
criteria.notes: Channel delivery remains optional and non-blocking.

criteria.description: Retry, dead-letter, audit, and skipped channel metrics are bounded, tenant-scoped, and redacted.
criteria.evidence: reliability.service.test.ts covers retry scheduling, dead-letter exhaustion, due retry dispatch, audit redaction, and skipped_no_channel metrics.

criteria.description: Producer integration and manual validation paths are present without requiring Slack, email, or channel setup.
criteria.notes: Manual route uses dashboard and monitoring acknowledgment as the non-channel baseline.

criteria.description: OpenAPI contract remains parseable after implementation quickstart updates.
criteria.notes: git diff --check passed in both target checkout and lane worktree.

negative_invariants.description: No client names or client-specific terminology are present in gateway fixtures, tests, docs, or examples.
negative_invariants.evidence: Gateway fixtures and docs use generic tenants, operators, dashboards, webhooks, review decisions, and monitoring alerts.

negative_invariants.description: Channel delivery absence is represented as skipped_no_channel rather than failed.
negative_invariants.evidence: delivery.service.test.ts and reliability.service.test.ts cover skipped_no_channel as terminal and separate from failures.

negative_invariants.description: Gateway services record routing and decisions but do not become the canonical lifecycle state store for pipeline review or monitoring domains.
negative_invariants.evidence: Decision handlers route into domain ports; pipeline review and monitoring remain domain-owned.
